method: Unaltered publication JPEGs. App applies a soft elliptical window, sky-pedestal subtraction, exposure gain and perspective projection. No AI alteration. Residual field stars within the windows remain part of the photographs; this is not a fully segmented extragalactic survey.

m31.jpg.credit: NASA, ESA, Digitized Sky Survey 2 (Acknowledgement: Davide De Martin)

video: Include these full credits visibly in the final video or its end credits; a YouTube description alone does not meet the observatories' requested attribution. The viewer's linked source credits are in the review panel.
